deliverable_form.method: OpenAPI Specification document as the contract of record

feedback_methodology.method: RFC 9110 HTTP-semantics compliance check (method/status-code correctness) on review

judgment_methodology.method: Google AIP resource-oriented design principles as the correctness lens for a new endpoint or field

planning_methodology.method: Microsoft REST API Guidelines versioning and breaking-change policy applied at design time

quality_bar.verification_method: spectral lint exit code / error count, zero errors against the project's OpenAPI ruleset
schema-conformance test suite run against recorded/contract responses for every documented status code
api-version-guard.sh's existing diff check, asserting a removed/renamed public field or endpoint carries a version bump
schema-conformance test scoped to documented 4xx/5xx responses against the project's declared error-shape schema

gates/quality_bar.py:human_comprehensibility_verdict against the role's own docs/issue-<n>/reports/<role>.md record text (gates/human_comprehensibility.py tier-1 structural prose rules: lead paragraph present, citation trailing placement, section size bound, no raw dump, enumeration cap); a record with no human-facing prose section anywhere is exempt (bar-met) -- issue #1623.

recomputation.checked_by: TBD (follow-up — issue-521 out-of-scope note: per-role recomputation enforcement is a follow-up once evidence from real usage shows which roles need it)
recomputation.rule: verdict is recomputed by re-running the spectral ruleset against the current endpoint_path, never a standalone asserted field (issue-515 invariant 4).

reference_resolution.rule: spectral_ruleset_id must resolve to an actual rule in the project's Spectral ruleset file — no orphan references (issue-515 invariant 2).

review_methodology.method: Structural OpenAPI diff (oasdiff) to catch a removed/renamed field or path with no version bump

record_spec.source_standard: Spectral ruleset (OpenAPI linting) + OpenAPI schema conformance, https://stoplight.io/open-source/spectral

use_when.board_condition: an OpenAPI spec file changed on the branch AND no api-design record exists yet for that commit sha

use_when: 여러 소비자가 걸리는 API 표면을 설계/변경할 때
